notes.title: X3: Farnham’s Legacy, a surprise free game in the X series, is out now
notes.notes:
Egosoft have just released X3: Farnham’s Legacy, a free game in their incredibly long-running space sandbox series (the first was released way back in 2005). The game was crafted by the Egosoft community, and is free to owners of X3: Albion Prelude. Hey, I own X3: AP! Yay for me! And hopefully yay for you, too.

Read more

notes.title: Unveiling X3: Farnham's Legacy – a new chapter for an old favourite
notes.notes:
We at Egosoft have been working on our current title, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/392160/X4_Foundations/]X4: Foundations[/url], and have recently released a [b]major 4.00 update[/b], as well as a new expansion, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1288460/X4_Cradle_of_Humanity/]X4: Cradle of Humanity[/url]. In the meantime, a new product has emerged from our DevNet community that we would like to tell you about.

Almost ten years ago, with the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/201310/X3_Albion_Prelude/]X3: Albion Prelude[/url], Egosoft decided to bring development of titles based on the long-running X3 game engine to an end. However, a [b]dedicated group of players from our DevNet community[/b] had other ideas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30511222/8453b2ecb60de68d1d4959c2356ad4bdf717be80.png[/img]

The [b]X3: Farnham's Legacy[/b] project kicked off in earnest in 2016 but, as with any community project, there were times when progress was faster than others. Five years on, and the team are now finally ready to show you their creation!

Set in the years after [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/201310/X3_Albion_Prelude/]X3: Albion Prelude[/url], as the chaos caused by the gate shutdown really takes hold, [b]X3: Farnham's Legacy[/b] starts very differently to previous games in the X3 series. Trapped in an isolated area of space, you'll first need to make use of the [b]new exploration features[/b] to find your way back to civilisation. Then, once you're there, you'll be able to use the [b]new diplomacy options[/b] to help shape your relationships with the factions you find.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B8Z9YDCXbdM
The new features don't end with the storyline, though. There are [b]numerous other improvements[/b], ranging from drone carriers, station-building services and an enhanced player headquarters, to a new ship browser and a hyperlinked encyclopedia. And of course, no new X3 game would be complete without [b]new ships and stations[/b]!

[b]X3: Farnham's Legacy will be released into Early Access on May 4th, 2021.[/b] The best news of all, however, is that this new expansion will be [b]FREE OF CHARGE to all owners of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/201310/X3_Albion_Prelude/]X3: Albion Prelude[/url][/b]!

In the four weeks until the release, we will provide you with interviews of the team members to further fuel the anticipation. Please keep an eye on our usual news channels.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/483330/X3_Farnhams_Legacy/

notes.title: Free X Weekend And New Updates!
notes.notes:
Egosoft is happy to announce that our first Virtual Reality game is finally ready for release. Today marks the end of Early Access and the launch of [b]X Rebirth VR Edition[/b].
[url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/570420/X_Rebirth_VR_Edition/[/url]
[b]To celebrate the launch of X Rebirth VR Edition, we will make all X games available for free for the upcoming weekend on Steam.[/b] You can play during the weekend and try out all the games from Egosoft that you do not own yet. Best of all: If you decide you want to buy one of them, there are some massive discounts too. Go and check out our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?sort_by=Price_DESC&developer=Egosoft]games on Steam[/url].

[b]End of Loyalty Discount: If you own X Rebirth and want VR Edition, buy NOW![/b]

We are going to end the X Rebirth VR Edition loyalty discount on December 10th when this sale ends. So if you own X Rebirth and are considering X Rebirth VR Edition, you can buy it with a 30% loyalty discount added on top of the 20% discount during this weekend at a [b]total of 50% off![/b]

[h1]New Updates for X Rebirth, X3TC and X3AP[/h1]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/2820/X3_Terran_Conflict/]X3: Terran Conflict 3.4[/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/201310/X3_Albion_Prelude/]X3: Albion Prelude 3.3[/url]: These two updates bring a couple of low level engine improvements for better performance especially during large battles. We also added a borderless window mode and fixed some bugs. More about these updates [url=https://forum.egosoft.com/viewtopic.php?p=4691927#4691927]here[/url].

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/570420/X_Rebirth_VR_Edition/]X Rebirth VR Edition 4.30[/url]: With the launch also come a number of new features for XR VR, including improved HOTAS and Joystick support and a method to play in VR with mouse and keyboard. See different methods of playing X Rebirth VR Edition explained in this video:
[url]https://youtu.be/Q9g9j-zjAxk[/url]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/2870/X_Rebirth/]X Rebirth 4.30[/url]: This update brings a number of improvements for controlling the game. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=950355253#2198759]Joystick and HOTAS improvements[/url] that we made during the XR VR development have been back ported to X Rebirth and come along with a default profile for some of the most popular sticks. Also controlling the game with gamepads got a lot easier thanks to a number of new features developed for X Rebirth VR Edition. Click [url=https://forum.egosoft.com/viewtopic.php?p=4548934#4548934]here[/url] for a full list of features.

[h1]X4 Announcement[/h1]

And in case you missed it:
[url]https://youtu.be/FuIeKMYaIAk[/url]

notes.title: X4: Foundations revisiting and expanding spacebasics
notes.notes: Spaceship explore-o-trade-a-shoot-y-sandbox series X will return revamped and expanded with X4: Foundations [official site], developers Egosoft announced over the weekend. They’ve muttered for years about what they’d fix and changed after 2013’s disappointing X: Rebirth and lawks, it looks like they’ve learned a lot. Spacemen will once again be able to fly every ship in the game rather than being locked to one, for starters. Transporters will let us teleport around between ships, the economy is more complex, factions are more alive, and… ah here, watch the announcement video introducing all this and more: (more…)

notes.title: X3: Terran Conflict 3.3 Update Released
notes.notes:
Since the last update, we've taken the opportunity to do a couple of things with these games. Most of these are fixes, and have been applied to both games (X3: TC + X3: AP); those of you with many playing hours will be pleased to note that one of these addresses the performance and memory issues that can occur with certain missions. 

Modders will find a few small improvements in X3AP, and players who use the Russian and Chinese localisations will hopefully be pleased to see text improvements that had been made in X3AP have now been back-ported to X3TC. Also back-ported to X3TC, though currently only in the Windows version, is the controller support from X3AP.

X3:TC 3.3 Changelog:[list]

[*]Added controller support (Windows only). 
[*]Updated Chinese and Russian localisation files. 
[*]Fixed various crashes and enabled crash dump generation. 
[*]Fixed various issues with joystick control. 
[*]Fixed mission-related memory leaks and performance issues. 
[*]Fixed duration of subtitles and displayed hints in several languages. 
[*]Fixed various user interface issues. 
[*]Fixed "invalid" being displayed instead of date/time in savegame load menu. 
[*]Fixed exploit in return ship mission where boarded ships remained player owned. 
[*]Fixed missions in Pirate or Yaki space not selecting correct enemies. 
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Cloud Sync Enabled
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that Steam Cloud support is now enabled for [u]all[/u] games in the X series, to bring the older games in line with X Rebirth. 

Your savegames will now be synchronised across different PCs using the same Steam account by default. 

If you do not wish to use Steam Cloud to synchronise your games, then right-click on the game in question in the Steam library, choose Properties, go to the Updates tab and uncheck the "Enable Steam Cloud synchronization" checkbox setting. 

You can, of course, re-enable it at any time if you change your mind.

Regards,

[i]Egosoft[/i]

notes.title: X3: Terran Conflict Bonus Package now available on Steam
notes.notes:
The [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/235940/]Bonus Package for X3: Terran Conflict[/url] has just been released on Steam. It's a free collection of script plugins that have been created by members of the Egosoft forum community. Egosoft has selected them as extensions that fit well into, and do not destroy, the balance of the game. To access the bonus content, simply install it from the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/235940/]store page[/url]. The Bonus Package will also show up in the DLC tab of the game properties, where you have the option to uninstall it.

If you have previously installed the non-Steam version of the Bonus Package, it is recommended that you uninstall it first.

notes.title: Humble Weekly Sale offers Egosoft catalogue, Indie Bundle gets more games
notes.notes:
Dammit, Humble guys. We leave you alone for a few days, and you barf up more games all over your website. There are two Humble happenings right now. Firstly, their Weekly Sale ticked over - kicking out the retro shooters and replacing them with the cold, dark void of Egosoft's space obsession. The entirety of the X-Series is being made available, minus the upcoming, spectacle promising, X-Rebirth. Secondly, over in the Humble mansion's main wing, the Indie Bundle 9 has added four more games, including Bastion and Limbo.

Here's what's in the Weekly Sale:


X: Beyond the Frontier
X-Tension
X2: The Threat
X3: Reunion plus its DLC X3: Reunion - Bonus Package
X3: Terran Conflict (for purchases above $6)
X3: Albion Prelude plus its soundtrack (for purchases above $6)
X-Superbox Bonus Material (for purchases above $6)
X-Rebirth soundtrack


Alternatively, replace that entire list with a man shouting "SPAAAAAAAAAAACE!" forever. It amounts to pretty much the same thing.

And now, in the more than $2.89 million raising Humble Indie Bundle 9, you can get the following for an above-the-average purchase:


Rocketbirds: Hardboiled Chicken
A Virus Named Tom
Bastion
Limbo


That's all for this weeks edition of "Humble: The 'Oh Dear God How Am I Going To Play All Of These Games' Story".

notes.title: X3: Terran Conflict Updated
notes.notes:
X3: Terran Conflict Update Released

This update, to version 3.2, brings several bug-fixes and performance improvements that have been back-ported from X3: Albion Prelude.

New Features and Improvements:

- CIG push effect now uses falloff
- Improved missile friendly fire behaviour
- Player missiles now immune to bullet damage for 2 seconds after launch
- Added new windowed mode resolutions and support for res.dat file
- Improved target rectangle scaling at high screen resolutions
- Several performance optimisations

Fixes:

- Fixed ships never docking at docking clamps unless SETA is engaged
- Fixed hitting Boost sending you back through the gate you have just come through
- Fixed some dialogue choice lines in the Buy Sector Information service
- Fixed rare broken handling of right mini-monitor
- Fixed rare crash when Game Over is shown
- Fixed rare Alt-Tab problem during startup
